analysis: Docs-only change to docs/architecture/components/console-ui.md (head text only, no patch or base text supplied). It changes no code, config or runtime behavior, so I found no security regression. The page describes existing console behavior. The upstream coordinator origin comes only from server env (lines 155, 230). The Privy and API-key paths are split (lines 144-151). The Stripe routes forward Privy credentials only if present (lines 118-124). CSP connect-src is limited to api.darkbloom.dev (line 203). Optional browser sealing goes through /api/chat, which forwards sealed bodies byte-for-byte (lines 181, 234). This matches T-003, T-017, T-019 and T-020 (mock auth). The doc states that GA consent defaults to granted with no opt-out (lines 207, 256) and that Datadog RUM runs with session replay sampling when it is configured (line 209). These are existing behaviors and are accurately disclosed. The doc also describes landing/ API routes (lines 291-298) that proxy inference and a provider-stories webhook with server-held credentials. The landing source was not supplied, so those claims are unverified. The doc cites no App Attest, attestation or provider-trust changes, so TB-009/TB-011 are unaffected. A later pass that includes landing/ code should examine the landing chat route and the webhook route for SSRF, credential exposure and rate limiting.
